newsitem.title: UK: PPL shares up on sheep-cloning breakthrough.
newsitem.headline: PPL shares up on sheep-cloning breakthrough.

text.p: Shares in PPL Therapeutics Plc rose sharply on Monday as the company confirmed a gene breakthrough than had enabled it to carry out the first-ever cloning of an adult sheep.
The stock was up 32-1/2p at 367-1/2 by 1515 GMT in volume of just 25,000 shares.
In a statement, the company said it had used a technique developed at the Roslin Institute near Edinburgh that allowed lambs to be produced from a variety of cell types.
This would allow the production of transgenic animals for a variety of research purposes, it said.
